walkthroughs.body_html:
Three classes of lever, by what's in the middle:

  • 1st class — Fulcrum in middle (head nodding on spine).
  • 2nd class — Load in middle (calf raise, ball of foot lifted).
  • 3rd class — Effort in middle (biceps curl — most common in body).

Mnemonic: 1-F, 2-L, 3-E.

Sagittal — divides left/right, allows forward/backward motion (running, somersault). Frontal — divides front/back, allows side movement (cartwheel, star jump). Transverse — divides top/bottom, allows rotation (discus throw, pirouette).
Flexion bends a joint, extension straightens it. Abduction moves a limb away from midline, adduction back toward it. Rotation turns around a long axis, circumduction draws a circle.
